meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器装上固定版本 @firecrawl/anydoc 0.1.6 CLI 和一个容器技能,让附件里的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等文档在容器内就地转成 Markdown,不经过托管解析器。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附件里的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等文档,又不希望把它们上传到托管解析服务时触发。

say.text: 把附件里的 DOCX、PPTX、XLSX 在容器内转成 Markdown 再总结
say.note: 转换在 agent 容器内完成,不上传

say.text: 确认纯图片的 PDF 会明确报错、不会被上传

howto.what_en: Installs the pinned @firecrawl/anydoc 0.1.6 CLI plus a container skill so NanoClaw agents convert attached Word, PowerPoint and Excel files to Markdown locally, without sending them to a hosted parser.
howto.when_en: Use when agents need to read attached office documents locally, without uploading them to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Convert the attached DOCX, PPTX and XLSX to Markdown in the container, then summarize
say_en.note: Conversion stays inside the agent container

say_en.text: Check whether @firecrawl/anydoc 0.1.6 passed the 72-hour release gate
Confirm an image-only PDF fails clearly and is not uploaded anywhere
